title: We Need To Honestly Talk About This Crash...
creator: Couch Investor
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble names/numbers in places
summary: Couch Investor reacts to a brutal sell-off day for the AI trade, calling it a bloodbath and a therapy session for growth investors. Neocloud names are down over 50% from their 52-week highs, AMD fell 12% after a strong report and Nvidia 6.7%, while only pockets like Exxon, Chevron and AppLovin (up 29.8% after earnings) were green. He works through Citrini Research's paid newsletter arguing the AI trade is over, rebutting it point by point: capex growth rates are falling but dollar amounts still rise (from $1 trillion toward $1.4 trillion); the near-$1 trillion hyperscaler spend versus $200 billion of AI revenue gap was already visible at the start of the year; backlogs are still over half a trillion dollars; and post-midterm data-centre permitting fears look overdone, with Meta saying existing centres and expansions should be fine. He also reads CoreWeave's CEO saying the election changes nothing for its commitments, with 1.5 GW active and 4.2 GW contracted. On his own book he bought a little Meta, Google and Nvidia, is tempted by Nebius before its report next week, and stays extremely bullish on Mercado Libre, now his top retirement-portfolio position after 45% revenue growth. FICO is his value-hunt pick after a record year, while Shift4 looks like a value trap on fading growth. His advice is patience: do not panic-sell and do not deploy all cash in one day. Calls: META, GOOGL and NVDA BUY (bought a little), MELI BUY, FICO CONDITIONAL_BUY, FOUR and ORCL UNCERTAIN. No prices were stated for the buys.
